storeUrls.title: Shopify store URLs or domains
storeUrls.description: Shopify storefronts to scrape, as domains or URLs. Example: gymshark.com or https://www.allbirds.com

collectionHandle.title: Collection handle (optional)
collectionHandle.description: Scrape only one collection instead of the whole catalog, e.g. new-arrivals (the part after /collections/ in the store URL).

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Cap on products returned per store. Controls total cost.

oneRowPerVariant.title: One row per variant
oneRowPerVariant.description: Return each variant (size, color) as its own row with the parent product's fields attached. Default is one row per product with variants nested.

includeImages.title: Include image URLs
includeImages.description: Attach product image URLs to each row.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Shopify's products.json endpoint works without any proxy from most environments.
